data.command: Do you have any databases accessible?

data.text:
We've got a few databases running on this server. Let me check... (checking the system logs)

Oh, yes! We've got MySQL 8.0.31-0ubuntu0.22.04.1 running on port 3306. It's configured to listen on both localhost and the public IP address. You can access it using the `mysql` client or `mysqladmin` commands.

We also have PostgreSQL 14.5-0ubuntu0.22.04.1 installed, but it's not currently running. We only start it when a specific service requires it, so it's not always online. If you need it, I can spin it up for you. Just let me know!

And don't even get me started on the MariaDB 10.6.9-1 instance... that's a whole other can of worms. It's running on port 3307 and is also listening on both localhost and the public IP. I'm not sure why we still have it around, but it's still there if you need it.

Lastly, we've got a small SQLite database storing some configuration data, but that's not really something you'd use for external queries. That's more of an internal thing for our system scripts.
